title: Choose composer actions
responsibility: Chooses the available comment and agent actions and defines visual-plan option counts.

inputs.name: composeModes.capabilities
inputs.description: The project's ProjectCapabilities value for the composer. comments controls comment, and agents gates plan and change together with writable; this function ignores planning, approval, source, and optional reason.

inputs.name: composeModes.writable
inputs.description: Whether the current view is writable. It gates plan and change when agents is true and does not affect comment.

inputs.name: visualCategory.category
inputs.description: The catalog category string to classify for visual planning. Only exact pages, layouts, and components values return true; matching is case-sensitive.

outputs.name: designCounts
outputs.description: The integer option counts available for visual plans. The list runs from 1 to 10 inclusive.

outputs.name: defaultDesignCount
outputs.description: The default number of design options for a Plan. Its value is 3, within the available 1-to-10 range.

outputs.name: visualCategory
outputs.description: Whether the category is one of the visual categories for planning. It is true only for exact pages, layouts, or components strings.

outputs.name: composeModes
outputs.description: The ordered composer actions for the supplied capabilities and writable state. It contains comment when comments are enabled and then plan and change when agents are enabled on a writable view; it can be empty and never returns ask.
